articles.title: Letters: Clover Road Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Please keep the streetlight upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Clover Road use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
To the editor: I have lived on Clover Road for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference Scout Troop 14 has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting. Please keep the streetlight upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Clover Road use it every week.
Isaac McIver, Stonebridge

articles.title: Council Tables Free Tax Clinic Ordinance
articles.deck: The vote came after 37 residents spoke at Saturday’s session.
body: Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days. The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

Public works estimates the work will take about 37 weeks once it starts in October. Residents of Tannery Flats said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.

Councilmember Edna Sokolov asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $850. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
